prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too optimistic for high forecasts, whereas zero or negative predictions underpredicted major wins.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) were generally helpful, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+4.6% and +6.6%), though one test performed worse (-4.6%).
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across both of its tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced inconsistent results, winning in 2 tests (+6.1% and +4.7%) while performing worse in 2 others (-4.4% and -9.3%).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout (1 win, 1 no clear effect) and all single-test categories, as at least 2 agreeing tests are needed to establish a pattern.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -0.8% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +7.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +6.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -15.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, hint: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: +3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.2% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] New Desktop Setup Check Screen: Add a dedicated setup check screen before waiting to confirm desktop display settings and pet visibility permissions. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on the desktop or failing to open, and home step has a high mean time of 2336s.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Story Stage Path Choice Flow: Introduce a new interactive story stage screen directly following the initial story to guide users into choosing their adoption path. (why: Choose path dropoff is 84.2% with a mean time of 514s; providing a guided story flow helps set expectations early.)
2: [adoption, hint] Upload Photo Lighting Guidance Hint: Add a clear hint to the photo upload screen recommending well-lit, clear pet photos for accurate generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step conversion is 72.7%.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Preparation Note: Update headline and body on the waiting screen to clarify that pet rendering is completing safely in the background. (why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear waiting screen messaging prevents user anxiety while waiting.)
4: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Shortcut Copy: Update headline and body on home_intro screen to clarify how to invoke the desktop pet overlay menu. (why: Support reported 3 emails from users confused about how to hide, control, or talk to their pet after completing onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Clear Distinction Headline: Update headline and body on choose_path screen to clearly distinguish between instant companion selection and custom photo adoption. (why: Path selection mean time is high (514s), suggesting hesitation between options.)
6: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid Choice Layout: Change layout of pick_friend screen to grid for quicker comparison of companion options. (why: Adoption stage target step dropoff is 72.7% with median 89s; grid view helps users browse choices faster.)

scores.note: Adding new setup check screen creates additional friction; new screen and flow changes historically yield negative results.

High dropoff stage supported by both funnel metrics and user emails; hint changes reliably show positive gains.
Low-cost copy update addressing long wait times, though past wait_info changes showed negligible overall lift.
Targets the highest funnel dropoff (finish step) supported by support emails; cheap copy change.
Simple copy clarity fix targeting path hesitation; config-only change with low risk.
